context: A mom consults a doctor about her family routine
purpose: Teach: 矯正/救急/注射/生理/医薬品/探る/本能/許容

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 先生、最近うちの家族の生活習慣が乱れていて、一度ご相談したくて来ました。
lines.en: Doctor, our family's lifestyle has gotten out of rhythm lately, so I came to consult you.
lines.style: Polite mother opening a family-routine consultation respectfully and warmly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。まずお子さんの食事や睡眠など、生理的なリズムから伺ってもいいですか。
lines.en: I see. May I start by asking about your child's meals, sleep, and other physiological rhythms?
lines.style: Calm professional doctor gathering daily-life background details carefully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夜更かしが続いていて、先月は熱で救急に駆け込んだこともあったんです。
lines.en: He keeps staying up late, and last month we even rushed to the emergency room with a fever.
lines.style: Concerned mother linking poor routine to a recent worrying incident.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 予防注射の時期も乱れがちですか。普段使っている市販の医薬品も教えてください。
lines.en: Are his vaccination schedules also slipping? Please tell me any over-the-counter medications you use.
lines.style: Methodical doctor probing routine-related health management details thoroughly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 歯並びの矯正も勧められているのですが、本人が嫌がっていて、気持ちを探るのが難しくて。
lines.en: Orthodontic treatment was also recommended, but he dislikes it, and it's hard to read his feelings.
lines.style: Reflective mother sharing multiple parenting concerns and emotional uncertainty.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お母さんの本能的な感覚は大切ですよ。多少の不規則さは許容できますが、無理は禁物です。
lines.en: Your motherly instinct matters. Some irregularity is acceptable, but don't push too hard.
lines.style: Reassuring doctor balancing empathy with clear medical guidance gently.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。家族全体の生活リズムを、もう一度見直してみますね。
lines.en: Thank you. I'll review our whole family's daily rhythm once again.
lines.style: Grateful mother committing to take constructive next steps forward.
